column1: # Functions the port implements on the host (Port J).  The one list:
#   hostify R17 makes the credited definitions of these weak (+ name__game alias)
#   gen_link_glue.py lists them in mvc2_fakes[]/stubs.csv and writes their
#   canonical prototypes to glue/mvc2_host_protos.h (generated stubs are weak).
# ret: return type override for a credited void function whose callers use $v0 (MIPS tail call)
# group: core = port/host/*.c (mvc2_host and mvc2); frontend = port/host/fe/*.c (mvc2 only)

column4: flInitialize: C port of the asm; arena + handle pool + video/VRAM bookkeeping + DMA queues; no IOP/GS
sbrk over a 28 MB host block (EE heap end)
vsync handler: vsync count + pending flip toggle; no GS registers
DMA kick: the built chain is complete at once (queue counters cleared)
flip: vsync + buffer swap + packet heap reset; frontend presents the frame
memory card wrapper init (C port of the asm; no sceMcInit)
ADXF_LoadPartitionNw: AFS partition from the disc image
ADXF_Open (locked): loose ISO file or AFS02 entry by name
ADXF_ReadNw: synchronous sector read from the image
ADXT_StartAfs: frontend ADX player (or PREP->PLAYING state machine)
Tamsoft flush -> tsd_client (frontend sink plays it)
TIM2 image pointer: the credited C is void but tail-calls func_003F5270 and callers use $v0
TIM2 CLUT pointer: credited void K&R wrapper tail-calls func_003F5440; callers use $v0
spawn helper (src/h2.c) returning the object in $v0 as its caller expects
camera compare: the credited C reads literal EE BSS addresses
end of scene: T0 sample from the host frame count
textured sprite: original texture check + frontend draw
memory card request/sync/retry state machine (C from the asm)
sceMcGetInfo: port 0 = formatted 8 MB PS2 card (host dir); port 1 empty
newlib _vfprintf_r: host vsnprintf (EE %l = 64-bit); string streams as newlib fills them
render state: game body + port/render fl_set_render_state (+ texture sync for 4..7)
default render state: game body + fl_default_state
scissor: game body + fl_set_scissor (frame buffer y doubled)
texture residency: game body (VRAM bookkeeping) + GL upload of changed records
texture unlock: game body + GL re-upload
palette unlock: game body + GL re-upload
VU0 3x3 matrix product (C from the asm)
POL mesh chunk -> clay: game body + remember the chunk
clay handle: game body + GL mesh (port/render fl_clay_build)
mesh draw: game body + fl_clay_draw (rebuild when the format word changed)
clay release: game body + GL release
VU0 4x4 matrix product (C for the inline COP2 asm)
character bank slot setup: game body + port/render FlCharBank
character slot release: game body + FlCharBank destroy
character sprite draw (asm VU1/GIF builder) -> fl_char_draw with the game's CLUTs
character box overlap test (C from the asm)
character resource setup: the game's own body + arcade-accuracy table splice (ARCADE_DIFF.md section 5; off by default)
animation script start: the game's own body + optional script trace (--arcade-trace)
animation script step: the game's own body + optional script trace (--arcade-trace)
hit reaction / damage: the game's own body + optional hit trace (--arcade-trace)
CPU team pick: the game's own body + --cpu-team forcing (testing)
queue a character PAK: --p1-team forcing (testing) + the game's own body
queue a character PAK (second path): --p1-team forcing (testing) + the game's own body
